001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
004
005import java.util.List;
006
007public interface Spectatable {
008
009    /**
010     * Get the spectators of the match/ffa/event.
011     * @return The spectators of the match/ffa/event
012     */
013    List<Player> getSpectators();
014
015    /**
016     * Add a spectator to the match/ffa/event.
017     * @param spectator The player that is spectating
018     * @param target The player that is being spectated
019     * @param teleport Whether the spectator should be teleported to the target
020     * @param message Whether the start of the spectating should be messaged
021     */
022    void addSpectator(Player spectator, Player target, boolean teleport, boolean message);
023
024    /**
025     * Remove a spectator from the match/ffa/event.
026     * @param player The player that is spectating
027     */
028    void removeSpectator(Player player);
029
030    /**
031     * Send a message to the match/ffa/event.
032     * @param message The message to send. Must be MM format.
033     * @param spectate Whether the message should be sent to spectators
034     */
035    void sendMessage(String message, boolean spectate);
036
037}
